name: spell
description: Spell's kit:  the layer every repo stands on (util, toolchain, server, element, its tools and test helpers, the spell command), the house style, and the ONE install over the child repos

scripts.kit:lint: vp lint --report-unused-disable-directives --max-warnings 0 src bin scripts tools tests vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts
scripts.kit:lint:fix: vp lint --fix src bin scripts tools tests vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts
scripts.kit:format: vp fmt src bin scripts tools tests vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.node.json tsconfig.tsx.json repos.json5 .yarnrc.yml .github .epic .claude-plugin
scripts.kit:format:check: vp fmt src bin scripts tools tests vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.node.json tsconfig.tsx.json repos.json5 .yarnrc.yml .github .epic .claude-plugin --check
scripts.kit:review:
yarn kit:ts && yarn kit:lint:fix && yarn kit:format && yarn kit:test && echo '== REVIEW PASSED
===========
'
